author: Times News
description:
The UAE has long marketed itself as an unshakeable oasis of luxury and stability, even as regional tensions simmer. But a direct conflict with Iran, marked by a barrage of missiles and drones, threatens the very foundation of that image. Beyond the immediate damage to oil stations and airports, the real crisis is one of perception. If the Emirates can no longer guarantee the safety of its residents and global tourists, the economic model of the last thirty years may finally reach its breaking point.
